<!--
Thanks for contributing! Please fill in the sections below. Small fixes
(typos, single-file bug fixes) can keep this short.
-->

## What does this PR do?

A one- or two-sentence summary of the change.

## Why?

The motivation — what problem this solves, or what it improves. Link any
related issue with `Closes #NNN`.

## Platforms tested

- [ ] Linux (specify distro + version)
- [ ] macOS (specify version + arch)
- [ ] Windows (specify version + WSL2 distro)
- [ ] CI only (compile check, lint)

## Checklist

- [ ] Ran `shellcheck` on any modified bash files
- [ ] Tested the affected installer on at least one real machine or VM
- [ ] Updated documentation (README, REQUIREMENTS, or per-platform notes) if
      behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal paths in the diff

## Screenshots / logs (optional)

If the change is user-visible, a before/after screenshot or a log excerpt
helps reviewers.
